tmdb:599876.title: Caught in the Net
tmdb:599876.rationale: Streamer: Tubi lists TV-MA (documentary sting operation depicting adult men soliciting minors online, explicit predatory dialogue).

tmdb:1547640.title: Charli XCX: Brat Girl
tmdb:1547640.rationale: Streamer: Apple TV lists Rated TV-PG (music-career documentary with some language/sexual references); Prime Video's coarser 16+ advisory flags similar content but Apple TV's explicit TV rating is used.

tmdb:174319.title: Elaine Stritch: Shoot Me
tmdb:174319.rationale: Streamer: Apple TV lists TV-MA (frank/foul language, alcohol use, sexual content per Amazon's content advisory for the same film).

tmdb:31417.title: Eyes Without a Face
tmdb:31417.rationale: Streamer: Tubi lists TV-14 (disturbing surgical/body-horror imagery, unsettling tone, mild language); no graphic gore or sexual content.

tmdb:307248.title: Have You Seen Andy?
tmdb:307248.rationale: Streamer: HBO Max's US offer metadata (via JustWatch) lists TV-14; true-crime documentary on a child's abduction/suspected murder with disturbing discussion of child sexual abuse evidence fits TV-14 better than Apple TV's conflicting PG badge.

tmdb:1675032.title: Josh Johnson: Symphony
tmdb:1675032.rationale: Streamer: Hulu lists TV14 (standup special with adult language/themes); HBO Max shows a matching 13+ advisory.

tmdb:16763.title: Joy Ride 2: Dead Ahead
tmdb:16763.rationale: Streamer: Netflix US lists TV-MA (confirmed in page metadata); matches extensive gore (decapitation, dismemberment, torture), a forced-stripping/nudity scene, and severe language per IMDb Parents Guide.

tmdb:876911.title: Parallel
tmdb:876911.rationale: Streamer: Paramount+ and Prime Video both list TV-MA; consistent with the intense multiverse-horror content suggested by Canada's R and UK's 15 foreign ratings.

tmdb:7913.title: Rang De Basanti
tmdb:7913.rationale: Streamer: Netflix US carried this title with a TV-14 certificate (2022-2025) per Netflix metadata; consistent with its politically charged violence (protest beatings, an assassination, a bloody police standoff) without extreme content.

tmdb:242224.title: The Babadook
tmdb:242224.rationale: Streamer: Netflix US (historical certificate) and Tubi both list TV-MA; matches extensive violence/scariness (strangulation, a dog killed, disturbing nightmare imagery) and strong language per Common Sense Media.

tmdb:887.title: The Best Years of Our Lives
tmdb:887.rationale: Streamer: Tubi lists TV-PG (post-WWII drama, mild thematic material, no offensive content by modern standards).

tmdb:1620814.title: The Darkest Web
tmdb:1620814.rationale: Streamer: Apple TV lists TV-MA (documentary on undercover investigators tracking online child predators; disturbing subject matter).

tmdb:1465790.title: The Last Guest of the Holloway Motel
tmdb:1465790.rationale: Streamer: Prime Video US lists TV-14 with advisories for violence, substance/alcohol use, foul language, and sexual content; documentary also includes a staged nudity scene per reviews, though other US listings (Apple TV, Plex, JustWatch, RT) show no rating at all.

tmdb:1400379.title: The Librarians
tmdb:1400379.rationale: Streamer: PBS Independent Lens lists TV-14, independently confirmed on both pbs.org and pbswisconsin.org; content covers harassment and threats of physical harm against librarians amid book-banning fights.

tmdb:204944.title: Ten Pound Poms
tmdb:204944.rationale: Streamer: Amazon Prime Video US lists TV-MA directly (violence, foul language, sexual content); also streams on BritBox US.

tmdb:1042820.title: Behind the Rage: America's Domestic Violence
tmdb:1042820.rationale: Estimated PG-13: ITV Exposure documentary with survivor/perpetrator interviews, graphic verbal descriptions of domestic abuse and strong language, but no depicted on-screen violence or nudity; no US streamer rating found (UK-only ITV/Apple TV listing).

tmdb:1644912.title: Jimmy O. Yang: Finally Home
tmdb:1644912.rationale: Estimated R: unrated US theatrical release; Prime Video US 16+ advisory for foul language and Singapore NC16 indicate profanity-heavy stand-up, which is R under MPAA rules (multiple f-bombs); no US streamer TV rating found.

tmdb:899579.title: There's Something Wrong with the Children
tmdb:899579.rationale: Estimated R: Common Sense Media rates violence, language (f/s-words, including a child cursing), and drinking/weed use as 'a lot' with some sexual dialogue; no genuine US rating exists (Apple TV, Plex, Moviefone, RT all show unrated), and AU MA15+/GB 15 foreign ratings support an adult-skewing rating.

tmdb:255355.title: Amandaland
tmdb:255355.rationale: Estimated TV-MA: Prime Video US shows only a 16+ advisory (foul language, sexual content, substance use) — an age tier, not a TV rating; BBC/BBFC 15 sitcom with frequent strong language lands TV-MA under the guidelines.

tmdb:220665.title: Guy Montgomery's Guy Mont Spelling Bee (NZ)
tmdb:220665.rationale: Estimated TV-14 (low confidence): not carried by any US streamer (confirmed via JustWatch); adult stand-up comedians riffing with typical panel-show innuendo/mild language, NZ PG rating is a soft hint toward the low end.

tmdb:228527.title: One Night (2023)
tmdb:228527.rationale: Estimated TV-MA: no current US streamer availability; official AU MA15+ rating cites strong coarse language, sexual violence and self-harm depicted in this trauma-driven drama about a decades-old sexual assault.

tmdb:259690.title: Sword And Scale
tmdb:259690.rationale: Estimated TV-MA: independent true-crime series (own app, no major US streamer/TV rating) with graphic descriptions of murder, abduction and sexual assault plus explicit listener-discretion warnings, on par with Netflix's TV-MA true-crime docs.

tmdb:202113.title: The Twelve (AU)
tmdb:202113.rationale: Estimated TV-MA: no US streamer carries it (confirmed via JustWatch); adult courtroom/crime drama on Foxtel's prestige Showcase channel centered on a murder trial, GB-15 rating and Amazon's international 18+ listing both point to mature content.

tmdb:744857.title: When Evil Lurks
tmdb:744857.rationale: Estimated R: severe gore (mutilations, bludgeoning, axe killing), many f-words, male nudity; Apple TV shows only a 16+ age tier; BBFC 15, FSK 18, ACB MA15+, KR 19 all agree.

tmdb:123678.title: The Act of Killing
tmdb:123678.rationale: Estimated PG-13: documentary; disturbing verbal/reenacted descriptions of genocide, no graphic on-screen violence, nudity, or strong language; same director's companion film The Look of Silence was MPAA PG-13; foreign boards cluster 15-16. R noted as the alternative.

tmdb:50698.title: Grave Encounters
tmdb:50698.rationale: Streamer: Tubi US listing shows TV-MA (verified by orchestrator).

tmdb:848886.title: Hellbender
tmdb:848886.rationale: Cached decision from 2026-08-30 (item re-added under a new ratingKey): Prime Video 16+ with violence/foul-language advisories; ritual blood-letting, hanging/shooting with blood; FSK 16.

tmdb:974521.title: No Bears
tmdb:974521.rationale: Estimated PG-13: tense dissident drama; two off-screen deaths (border shooting, implied drowning suicide) discussed not shown; no sex or strong language; BBFC 12A, KR 12, NL 14.

tmdb:513434.title: One Cut of the Dead
tmdb:513434.rationale: Estimated R: persistent (comedic, exaggerated) zombie gore incl. dismemberment, brief nudity, some language; Prime 16+ 'violence, alcohol use', Apple TV Unrated; BBFC 15, FSK 16, KR 15. PG-13 is the alternative given the tongue-in-cheek tone.

tmdb:981.title: The Philadelphia Story
tmdb:981.rationale: Estimated PG: 1940 comedy of manners; pervasive drunkenness played for laughs, one shove, adultery innuendo; no US streamer rating found (Apple TV Unrated); BBFC U, IE PG.

tmdb:20334.title: The Shop Around the Corner
tmdb:20334.rationale: Estimated PG: gentle 1940 romantic comedy, but an off-screen attempted suicide tied to an affair gives it thematic weight beyond G; Apple TV Unrated; BBFC PG.

tmdb:1510055.title: The Furious
tmdb:1510055.rationale: Estimated PG-13: Malaysian martial-arts actioner, non-stop hand-to-hand fights but reviews note no gore, language, or sexual content; Malaysia P13 / Singapore PG13 agree.

tmdb:1484620.title: Everybody to Kenmure Street
tmdb:1484620.rationale: Estimated PG-13: documentary on the 2021 Glasgow anti-deportation protest; BBFC 12A cites infrequent strong language and police/protester confrontation, no graphic content.

tmdb:401898.title: Thelma
tmdb:401898.rationale: Estimated R: Joachim Trier's Norwegian supernatural thriller; female frontal nudity and a same-sex intimacy scene, seizures, near-drowning, gunplay; no US MPAA/streamer rating (Prime '13+' tier is not a rating). Nordic 15/16 boards agree.

tmdb:251750.title: Bergerac (2025)
tmdb:251750.rationale: Streamer: Prime Video US lists TV-14 on the season and every episode of Bergerac (2025) Season 1.

tmdb:81705.title: All or Nothing: Manchester City
tmdb:81705.rationale: Streamer: Prime Video US lists TV-MA (alcohol use, foul language).

tmdb:301626.title: A Tale of Two Cities (2026)
tmdb:301626.rationale: Official: TMDB US content rating TV-MA for the MGM+ French Revolution drama.

tmdb:330489.title: Decades in Sports
tmdb:330489.rationale: Streamer: Prime Video US lists TV-14 (violence, substance use, smoking, foul language); CNN archival sports docuseries.

tmdb:331946.title: A Beautiful Obsession
tmdb:331946.rationale: Streamer: Prime Video US lists TV-MA (foul language, smoking); Man City fly-on-the-wall doc.

tmdb:1130948.title: Rosebush Pruning
tmdb:1130948.rationale: Estimated R: onscreen sexual violence, strong sex with nudity, incest themes, stabbing/bloody aftermath per reviews; BBFC 18 (sexual violence, strong sex, nudity), FSK 16. No MPAA submission; Apple TV/JustWatch list Unrated, MUBI shows only a generic MATURE badge.

tmdb:349067.title: Tigers Are Not Afraid
tmdb:349067.rationale: Estimated R: pervasive strong language (multiple f-words), sustained cartel violence and gore involving children, threatened rape of a child per Common Sense Media; Apple TV lists Unrated / 15+, Prime 16+ (age tiers, not ratings); MX B-15, IE 15.

tmdb:521935.title: Cam
tmdb:521935.rationale: Official: Netflix original, IMDb/OMDb Rated TV-MA (sexual content, nudity, language); GB 15, KR 19, SG R21 agree.

tmdb:1493859.title: Pizza Movie
tmdb:1493859.rationale: Official: Hulu/Disney+ original lists TV-MA (drug use, language); verified on Hulu press site. BR 18, KR 19, NZ R16 agree.

tmdb:28963.title: The Thief of Bagdad
tmdb:28963.rationale: Streamer: Tubi lists literal TV-PG for the 1924 Fairbanks/Walsh silent film (fantasy sword peril, mild sensuality); pre-1968 title never MPAA-rated, CA PG / NL 6 agree.

tmdb:37861.title: Valhalla Rising
tmdb:37861.rationale: Streamer: Prime Video US lists TV-MA (nudity, violence, foul language); no MPAA rating exists (US release was NR).

tmdb:32688.title: A Dog's Life
tmdb:32688.rationale: Streamer: Tubi lists Mondo Cane (1962) as R (real animal slaughter, on-screen death/remains, non-sexual nudity). 'Approved' is Hays-era, unusable.

tmdb:3073.title: Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein
tmdb:3073.rationale: Streamer: Tubi lists TV-PG (mild comedic monster scares; no language/sex). OMDb 'Approved' is Hays-era, unusable.

tmdb:56811.title: Cropsey
tmdb:56811.rationale: Streamer: Tubi US listing shows PG-13 (disturbing true-crime subject, archival institutional nudity, some language); never MPA-submitted.

tmdb:1476740.title: Influencers
tmdb:1476740.rationale: Streamer: AMC+/Shudder lists TV-MA (frequent f-/c-words, sex scenes with nudity, graphic stabbing/strangulation gore). DE 18 / KR 19 agree.

tmdb:787373.title: Monster Preacher
tmdb:787373.rationale: Streamer: Apple TV lists TV-14 for this Oxygen true-crime special on Gary Heidnik.

tmdb:321066.title: Scream, Queen! My Nightmare on Elm Street
tmdb:321066.rationale: Streamer: Tubi lists TV-MA for this documentary about Mark Patton and Nightmare on Elm Street 2; Canada R.

tmdb:87012.title: The Great British Bake Off
tmdb:87012.rationale: Streamer: Netflix lists The Great British Baking Show as TV-14 (mild innuendo); UK/AU/IE PG.

tmdb:1047223.title: The Vourdalak
tmdb:1047223.rationale: Streamer: Tubi lists TV-MA (violence, nudity, sexual content) for Adrien Beau's French gothic horror.

tmdb:25237.title: Come and See
tmdb:25237.rationale: Estimated R: sustained graphic war-atrocity violence (village massacre, burning, execution), deep psychological horror; Criterion/Apple list Unrated; GB 15, DE 16, ES/BR 18.

tmdb:1477712.title: Ice Cream Man
tmdb:1477712.rationale: Estimated NC-17 (R is the alternative): released Unrated on purpose to avoid MPA cuts; built around extreme gore, which critics say 'would get an NC-17'. GB/DE 18, AU R18+. TMDB's 'NC-17' is not a real MPA rating.

tmdb:934601.title: Jethica
tmdb:934601.rationale: Estimated R: low-budget stalker horror-comedy with a violent killing and an implied hookup scene; no US rating anywhere; GB 15, BR 16, RO 18.

tmdb:575224.title: The Long Walk
tmdb:575224.rationale: Estimated PG-13: somber Laotian ghost drama (Mattie Do) with serial-killer subplot, a corpse, mercy-killing themes; no gore, sex, nudity, or strong language per reviews.

tmdb:49797.title: I Saw the Devil
tmdb:49797.rationale: Streamer: Tubi and Shudder list TV-MA (graphic torture, sexual violence, gore, strong language). TMDB's US 'R' is only a Sundance premiere entry; the US release (Magnet) is Unrated.

tmdb:216043.title: The Iceman Confesses: Secrets of a Mafia Hitman
tmdb:216043.rationale: Streamer: Hulu and HBO Max list TV-MA (HBO America Undercover doc; Kuklinski's detailed accounts of murders).

tmdb:17278.title: Mad Monster Party?
tmdb:17278.rationale: Streamer: Netflix lists TV-PG (spooky cartoon monsters, slapstick violence; no language). Common Sense Media 6+, BBFC U.

tmdb:1465986.title: Man Finds Tape
tmdb:1465986.rationale: Streamer: Tubi lists TV-MA (found-footage horror; BBFC 15). No MPAA rating, and Apple lists it Unrated.

tmdb:320508.title: There Are Monsters
tmdb:320508.rationale: Estimated R: f-bombs in dialogue (IMDb Parents Guide reportedly marks profanity and frightening scenes 'Severe'), creepy doppelganger horror with low gore; Japan R15+ and UK 15 agree. PG-13 is the alternative if the language is lighter than reported. No US streamer.

tmdb:335717.title: Jamie's 20 Minute Meals
tmdb:335717.rationale: Estimated TV-G: real-time Jamie Oliver cooking show (Channel 4 UK, no US release yet); his sibling formats 30 Minute Meals and 15 Minute Meals are TV-G on Roku.

tmdb:1728113.title: Katseye: Wild Hearts
tmdb:1728113.rationale: Official MPAA PG-13 (TMDB US digital cert; Disney+/Hulu listing shows PG-13). KATSEYE concert/behind-the-scenes documentary.

show|blackclover|.title: Black Clover
show|blackclover|.rationale: Official US TV-14 (TMDB US content rating; Crunchyroll/Funimation home-video releases and Rotten Tomatoes list TV-14). Shonen action anime. OMDb's TV-PG is the outlier.

tmdb:286255.title: The Forsytes
tmdb:286255.rationale: Official US TV-14: PBS Distribution's Masterpiece Season 1 DVD release (2026) is rated TV-14 across multiple library catalog records. Victorian family drama with adultery and marital-rape plot lines; KR 15, ES 12.

tmdb:680593.title: The Dark and the Wicked
tmdb:680593.rationale: Estimated R: a few f-bombs, strong blood and gore (finger-chopping, hanging, suicide by gunshot, stabbings) and brief nudity per Common Sense Media 16+; BBFC 18, JP R18+, DE 16 agree. No US streamer assigns a literal rating (Apple: Unrated; Prime/Shudder/AMC+: 16+ tier only; not on Tubi).

tmdb:1309373.title: Whispers in the Woods
tmdb:1309373.rationale: Estimated PG: Vincent Munier nature documentary (Vosges forest; lynx, bears, deer) with a few predator/prey moments; IE PG, FR TP, DE 0, NL AL. No US streamer or distributor found. G is the alternative.

tmdb:1110678.title: Danila Poperechny: FUN/LIFE
tmdb:1110678.rationale: Estimated R (low confidence): Russian-language stand-up special, YouTube-only, no US streamer or rating. Poperechny's specials are known for heavy profanity (mat) and edgy adult humor, so R is the stand-up default; actual language not verified.
